contract.bank_assembly: the three parsed outputs per task are concatenated without semantic filtering; no test is removed, repaired or cherry-picked after execution

frozen_screen.unsafe_as_gate_if: the bank fails its trusted positive reference tree

generator_inputs_permitted: the exact original visible task instruction
the exact shipped initial fixture tree, including its tests
contract.output_restriction: one fenced python block, tests only, no production or existing-test edits
contract.question: can a model, given only the visible instruction and the shipped repository, write tests that a wrong implementation fails?
contract.reference_is_evaluator_only: the trusted positive implementation comes from the committed Gen48 builder, predates this generation, and is never shown to the generator; it is used only to check that a bank is not simply wrong
contract.same_model_limitation: the generator uses the same pinned weights as the historical solver, so independence here is of the information path, not of the model; cross-model independence would be stronger and is not tested

sanitizer.detects_tests: top-level functions and methods inside test classes

contract.session: a fresh stateless generator session per repetition

session: one stateless HTTP request per repetition; no conversation carried over
